interface.signature: def canFinish(n: int, prerequisites: list[list[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The number of courses n is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < n and 0 <= v < n for u, v in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Every prerequisite pair [u, v] contains valid course labels within the range [0, n-1].

preconditions.expression: len(prerequisites) == len(set(tuple(p) for p in prerequisites))
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate edges in the prerequisites list.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if a topological ordering of all n courses exists (i.e., the graph is a DAG), and False otherwise.
